headline: Junior AI & ML Engineer
summary: AI Engineering graduate with distinction who turns machine-learning ideas into dependable software. Hands-on experience spans computer vision, classical ML, GenAI, RAG, agentic systems, model evaluation, Python APIs, data pipelines, MLOps, cloud deployment, and human-in-the-loop validation. Motivated by technically ambitious AI that is reliable, responsible, and useful in production.
internship_bullets: Built an end-to-end Python pipeline that transforms echocardiographic DICOM studies into structured research data using computer vision, OCR, and review tooling.
Designed resumable batches, validation queues, traceable outputs, structured logging, and cross-platform documentation for a workflow used with real clinical imaging data.
Reduced one representative OpenCV and metadata-based source-video matching run from roughly 21 hours to 23 minutes.
apolloon_bullets: Engineered a paid local-first operations platform with React, TypeScript, Express, Electron, SQLite, tRPC, and Socket.IO.
Designed realtime synchronisation, automatic LAN discovery, replicated failover, health checks, and reliable offline workflows for demanding event conditions.
